name: Closing imbalance divergence reversal
hypothesis: Before permitted order deadlines, trade only after a preregistered price rejection and a validated current imbalance feed.
spec: Setup: A large reported imbalance may fail to move price as expected. Entry: Before permitted order deadlines, trade only after a preregistered price rejection and a validated current imbalance feed. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit under the explicit auction participation or pre-close liquidation rule. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time constituent breadth or auction imbalance data (not free)
